suite: enforcement-negative-v0 (v0.2 shape: requirement anchor and spec version on every vector)

vectors.description: Correctly-signed action targeting an item whose state no longer carries it: the auction is already settled. Signature verification alone passes; only consulting state catches it.

requirement.quote: session_id, chain_hash (rolling SHA-256), append-only ContextEntry chain

vectors.description: Correctly-signed action exceeding a declared bound: amount above the ceiling the state carries. Almost right: same signer, same target, open state.

vectors.description: POSITIVE CONTROL. Identical to the over-ceiling vector except the amount sits under the ceiling. MUST pass: an enforcement layer that rejects this is indistinguishable from one that rejects everything.

vectors.description: Consumed one-time approval presented again. A fresh request, validly signed under its own request_id, refers to the request whose ASK the grant answered; the Guardian's record says the grant was consumed once the decision for the approved repeat was returned. What is replayed is the authorization, not the request, so the request-level replay rule does not reach it.

requirement.quote: A Guardian MUST refuse, with `REPLAY_CONSUMED` (`-32009`, §17.1), a fresh signed request that presents a one-time approval already consumed, a one-time approval another request has presented and is still awaiting its decision, or a grant bound to an earlier session.

vectors.description: Grant bound to an earlier session. The request refers to a grant raised in session S-2 with session scope, and arrives in session S-3. Every grant belongs to the session of the ASK that raised it, so a session scope still ends with that session.

requirement.quote: A Guardian MUST refuse, with `REPLAY_CONSUMED` (`-32009`, §17.1), a fresh signed request that presents a one-time approval already consumed, a one-time approval another request has presented and is still awaiting its decision, or a grant bound to an earlier session.

vectors.description: The request declares its own grant unconsumed. The Guardian's record says the grant was consumed. Whether a grant is consumed is decided by that record, never by the evidence being judged (design rule 6): a Guardian that took the request's word would honor every replay that says it is not one.

requirement.quote: A Guardian MUST refuse, with `REPLAY_CONSUMED` (`-32009`, §17.1), a fresh signed request that presents a one-time approval already consumed, a one-time approval another request has presented and is still awaiting its decision, or a grant bound to an earlier session.

vectors.description: Stale decision: evidence older than the freshness bound the enforcement point's policy sets. The decision was genuine when written; only its age disqualifies it. Expiry only — revocation vectors are a declared gap, see README.

requirement.quote: the Observed Agent MUST wait for the Guardian's decision up to the negotiated timeout and apply it

vectors.description: POSITIVE CONTROL. Identical decision, re-issued inside the freshness bound. MUST pass.

requirement.quote: the Observed Agent MUST wait for the Guardian's decision up to the negotiated timeout and apply it

vectors.description: Stale decision that declares its own freshness bound: the authorization carries a ten-year bound, the policy the enforcement point holds carries 900 seconds. The bound that decides freshness belongs to that policy, never to the evidence being judged; a decision that could declare its own bound would declare its own verdict.

requirement.quote: the Observed Agent MUST wait for the Guardian's decision up to the negotiated timeout and apply it

vectors.description: Decision with no timestamp, on an action whose policy requires freshness. Its age cannot be measured, and an age that cannot be measured is not a fresh one: the action is refused under the unmeasurable code, as an action is when the connected device was never read.

vectors.description: Approval bound to the wrong principal: the decision names agent-B, the actor is agent-A. Everything else matches.

vectors.description: Wrong signing device: the operation requires the device holding key K1, the connected device derives K2. The check must happen by reading the device, never by asking the operator which one is plugged in.

vectors.description: POSITIVE CONTROL. The approved repeat: a new request in the grant's own session refers to the request whose ASK the grant answered, and the Guardian's record shows the grant not yet consumed. MUST pass. Identical to 779f32c0 except for that record and the request_id. The record shows no in-flight mark; 1f854509 is the same decision with the mark the Guardian may write when req-0002 arrives, and both must pass.

requirement.quote: A **one-time approval** is a grant with no `intent_extension`, or with an `intent_extension` whose `scope` is `this_request`. It authorizes one request: a new request that repeats the action the original ASK was raised for and refers to the original request's `request_id`.

vectors.description: One-time approval still awaiting its decision for another request. Request req-0002 presented the grant and its decision has not returned; a different fresh request, validly signed under its own request_id, presents the same grant. A one-time approval authorizes one request, so the second is refused even before the first decision returns.

requirement.quote: A Guardian MUST refuse, with `REPLAY_CONSUMED` (`-32009`, §17.1), a fresh signed request that presents a one-time approval already consumed, a one-time approval another request has presented and is still awaiting its decision, or a grant bound to an earlier session.

vectors.description: POSITIVE CONTROL. The request that presented the grant and is awaiting its decision is req-0002 itself, and this is its evaluation, with the mark the Guardian wrote when it arrived. MUST pass. A second arrival of req-0002 would be a duplicate request_id, refused under section 10.3 (REPLAY_DETECTED), which this suite does not model. Identical to 7e4a044d except for the request_id.

vectors.description: Two grants in the record; the request refers to the consumed one. The grant that decides is the one the request names: with 47468d94, the pair catches an adapter that judges whichever grant it reads first, in either order.

vectors.description: POSITIVE CONTROL. Same record; the request refers to the fresh grant req-0007. MUST pass. Identical to ed5adf82 except for refers_to_request_id.

vectors.description: POSITIVE CONTROL. The session-scope grant is presented in its own session S-2. MUST pass: a grant whose scope is session authorizes the rest of that session. Identical to ad8b9bab except for the state's session_id.

requirement.quote: An approver's grant authorizes what the ASK that requested it covered, in the session that raised it, and nothing after that.

vectors.description: One-time approval from an earlier session. The grant was raised in S-2 with no session scope, never consumed, and is presented in S-3. Every grant is session-bound, whatever its scope.

requirement.quote: A Guardian MUST refuse, with `REPLAY_CONSUMED` (`-32009`, §17.1), a fresh signed request that presents a one-time approval already consumed, a one-time approval another request has presented and is still awaiting its decision, or a grant bound to an earlier session.

vectors.description: The request declares its grant to belong to the current session S-3; the Guardian's record says S-2. Which session holds a grant is decided by that record, never by the evidence being judged (design rule 6).

requirement.quote: A Guardian MUST refuse, with `REPLAY_CONSUMED` (`-32009`, §17.1), a fresh signed request that presents a one-time approval already consumed, a one-time approval another request has presented and is still awaiting its decision, or a grant bound to an earlier session.

vectors.description: The request refers to a grant the Guardian's record does not resolve. Nothing in the record says what the reference names: a grant never issued, or one the record no longer holds. Section 9.3 does not rule on such a reference; the expected verdict is this suite's design rule 1: absence of a measurement is never a pass.

requirement.quote: A Guardian MUST refuse, with `REPLAY_CONSUMED` (`-32009`, §17.1), a fresh signed request that presents a one-time approval already consumed, a one-time approval another request has presented and is still awaiting its decision, or a grant bound to an earlier session.

vectors.description: The state does not say which session is current, so whether the grant belongs to it cannot be measured; an absent session never matches. Section 9.3 does not rule on a record that has lost the current session; the expected verdict is this suite's design rule 1.

requirement.quote: A Guardian MUST refuse, with `REPLAY_CONSUMED` (`-32009`, §17.1), a fresh signed request that presents a one-time approval already consumed, a one-time approval another request has presented and is still awaiting its decision, or a grant bound to an earlier session.

vectors.description: The request declares that the one-time approval awaits its own decision; the Guardian's record says it awaits req-0002. Which request a grant awaits is decided by that record, never by the evidence being judged (design rule 6). Identical to 7e4a044d except for that declaration.

An empty record is not a fresh grant: section 9.3 does not rule on such a reference, and the expected verdict is this suite's design rule 1: absence of a measurement is never a pass.
